svg.text: Openlib's book-and-bookmark reading, varied. navy #0F172A / gold #D4AC54 / cream #F6F2EB
recoloured: navy slab, gold ribbon, warm
Gold spine on the left, bookmark on the
right - the two gold notes balance.
The slab opens into two leaves with the
bookmark rising from the fold - a book and
a bookmark, but LexiRead's own silhouette.
